message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. Fact: Liu was caught with 13 packages of white crystal, presumably heroin. He purchased from Peng. The prosecution says he held heroin more than 10 grams, constituting the crime of "持有毒品罪" (possession of narcotics). So the crime is "持有毒品罪". In Chinese official term: "持有毒品罪". Should we include "贩卖毒品罪"? No, Liu only possessed, not selling. So single crime.

Thus output format: [罪名]持有毒品罪<eoa>
